Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Established diagnosis of UC for at least 3 months prior to screening, [AND]  with minimum disease extent of 15 cm from the anal verge
  -  Mildly to moderately active UC
  -  Inadequate response to ongoing treatment with oral mesalamine ≥2

right.raw_text:
4 g/day for ≥4 weeks from screening visit
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Possible or confirmed diagnosis of Crohn's Disease  [OR] or other forms of inflammatory bowel disorders
  -  Ongoing  [OR] or failed prior treatment for UC with methotrexate, [OR]  azathioprine,
     6-mercaptopurine, [OR]  cyclosporine, [OR]  tofacitinib, [OR]  mycophenolate mofetil, [OR]  sirolimus (rapamycin), thalidomide, [OR]  tacrolimus (FK-506) [OR] , or biologics (e

left.raw_text: , TNF-alpha-antagonists, [OR]  anti-integrin therapies, [OR]  or agents targeting IL-12  [OR] or IL-23, etc

right.raw_text:
)
  -  Any immunosuppressive condition  [OR] or treatment with immunosuppressive medications
  -  History of prior surgical intervention in any region of the gastrointestinal tract (excluding minor surgery)
  -  Prior diagnosis of any cardiovascular, [OR]  renal, [OR]  hepatic, [OR]  endocrine, [OR]  infectious, [OR]  hematological, [OR]  oncologic, [OR]  neuro-psychiatric  [OR] or immune-mediated disorder, which in the opinion of the Principal Investigator might impact the subject's safety or compliance, or the interpretation of results
  -  Treatment with any other investigational drugs ≤12 weeks prior to baseline visit
  -  The participant has a condition or is in a situation which, in the Principal Investigator's opinion, may put the participant at significant risk, may confound the study  [OR] results, or may interfere significantly with the participant's participation in the study
